quote: This game is the worst of the series, a cuck simulator. Stupid story, stupid missions, and don't even start on the "freedom" that they promised. Refunded.

author: felixmoysich
quote: The Game begins strong with a interesting open world, the combat and survival-aspect in the first third is really challenging and the story has its highlights... but the more you play it gets more and more boring. The only highlight of the second map is the city of Kuttenberg. Otherwise mainly fast travel here, fast travel there and return. The story and characters get more and more cliché and the game gets way too simple. I played 100+ hours but couldn't finish it because it became too boring in the end. All in all a very ambitious project but unfortunately ruined by too many bad decisions, unlikeable characters and tedious open world and story. (in the second half of the game)

author: felixmoysich
quote: At first I enjoyed it but it became way too repetitive and boring,I even couldn't play it till the end. Miles from GoW1 and 2, which were far more impressive. This game just combines things from other Action/Open World games and puts hardly anything new to it except cool cinematics.

author: felixmoysich
quote: Very average game incredibly overrated. First hours fighting and exploring was fun but it then becomes really repetitive and boring so I had to stop playing. There are much better RPGs. I rate it a 6/10.

author: felixmoysich
quote: Most overhyped game ever. It was fun the first hours, but after about 60 hours repetitive gameplay playing it became a pain and I had to stop. For a Soulslike its mediocre and for an RPG ist's even below that. Normally I would have rated it a 5,but because all the biased 90+reviews I have to rate it a 0/10.

author: felixmoysich
quote:
What a Game! Epic and extremely underrated. One of the best yet. Played it now for 200+ hours and still addictve.
Buy and play!

author: felixmoysich
quote: This game is very boring and mediocre.Controls are really bad,animation too. From the beginning on,you have to grind a lot to be able to beat the bosses,it is just stupid. I really liked DS1 and 3, but in this game everything seems random and generic. There are hardly any real goals to achieve,you are just wandering around without sense and reason, waiting for the next enemy horde to slaughter. I really cannot understand how this game could get such high reviews,maybe it's a pandemic spread of people just having lost their minds over the last years.
